CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation bound to identified content.

COD.rationale: Content (red set), organization/presentation (spatial coordinates) and an origin/status entry are explicitly present for the same referent and time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition is bound to an identified content's organization/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifications with attributes (red/blue) are present.

D.rationale: Origins/kind fields separately attribute status/estimation metadata to identified contents.

O.rationale: Spatial coordinate lists describe how the identified color contents are presented/organized.
